current.text: He has a torn patellar tendon and is out.
A return in March is likely. One expert would be pleasantly surprised if he returns before March.
His role after his return is unclear. The Warriors rotation will shift again when he and Jimmy Butler come back.
The Warriors are reported to treat this season as a gap year. They are worried about lottery odds and may rest veterans.
The Warriors schedule is good for fantasy playoffs that end on March 28.

durable.text: He has had knee problems since college.
